critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix at ebidding-automation.js ~line 195 correctly removes httpsAgent/httpAgent from the wrapped axios client — axios-cookiejar-support requires its own undici cookie-aware agent and rejects any custom agent, so this is the right resolution.
If keep-alive is later needed for perf, it must be provided via the cookie jar wrapper's own options rather than a raw http(s).Agent; document this so it isn't reintroduced.
